title: National Dog Show 2026: A Thanksgiving Viewing Guide for French Bulldog Fans
seoTitle: National Dog Show 2026: How to Watch, New Breeds
description: The 25th National Dog Show airs Thanksgiving Day on NBC and Peacock. When to watch, the three breeds making their debut, and where the French Bulldog competes.
secondaryKeywords: how to watch national dog show

faq.q: What time is the National Dog Show on Thanksgiving 2026?
faq.a: Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026, from noon to 2 p.m. in all U.S. time zones on NBC and Peacock, right after the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

faq.q: What new breeds are in the 2026 National Dog Show?
faq.a: The Teddy Roosevelt terrier (Terrier Group), the Russian tsvetnaya bolonka (Toy Group) and the Basset fauve de Bretagne (Hound Group).

faq.q: What group is the French Bulldog in?
faq.a: The American Kennel Club places the French Bulldog in the Non-Sporting Group.

faq.q: Who won Best in Show at the 2025 National Dog Show?
faq.a: Soleil, a Belgian sheepdog. The 2026 winner is revealed in the Thanksgiving broadcast.

faq.q: Who hosts the National Dog Show?
faq.a: David Frei and John O'Hurley co-host the broadcast, with Mary Carillo as features reporter. The event itself is hosted by the Kennel Club of Philadelphia.
